diagnostics.message: The analysis completed, so a quantity may be reported as measured - but only once a typed measurement envelope carries it. A number parsed out of the raw file by hand is not one: nothing in the result contract binds it to this run. This envelope has been retained at /evidence/sim/xyce-ac/simulate.result.json. The retained raw declares 'frequency' as the axis - which must NOT appear in selectors - over the vectors V(1). Continue with: openada extract --simulation /evidence/sim/xyce-ac/simulate.result.json --artifact /evidence/sim/xyce-ac/xyce-ac-derived/xyce-ac-derived.xyce.raw --selection /evidence/sim/xyce-ac/simulate.selection.json, then `openada transfer` on the series it returns. Its metric kinds are low_frequency_gain_db (dB), low_frequency_impedance (Ohm, output in V over input in A), bandwidth_3db, unity_gain_frequency and phase_margin. Each operand is a Cartesian {real, imaginary} pair and may add negative_real/negative_imaginary to become differential, which is how a differential gain and any other two-terminal ratio becomes one typed measurement instead of arithmetic in an answer. The amperes an impedance needs are the `i(<source>)` vectors already listed in the selection file: hold the node with a 1 V AC source and name that source's current as the input. Run `openada transfer --help` for the exact shape.
